```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(fitPCurve)
library(rio)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)

# The working directory should be the project root
# if quarto:render is called
if (!interactive()) {
  print("Switching working directory to project root")
  setwd("..")
}

# reference p-curves
pcurves <- import("simulations/avg_pcurve_simulation_study/avg_pcurve.csv")

# p-curves with 500 iterations
pcurves500 <- import("simulations/avg_pcurve_simulation_study/avg_pcurve_500.csv") %>% 
  filter(sample.num != 00) #these are the average p-curves computed above

# load the multiple DV simulation results:
simres <- import("simulations/sim-results/simres_full.RData")

```

Re-shape pcurves500 into long form
```{r}
pcurves500_long <- pcurves500 %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(p1:p5), names_to = "pval", values_to = "yval")

  pcurves500_long$pval <- substr(pcurves500_long$pval, 2, 2) |> as.numeric()
  pcurves500_long$pval <- pcurves500_long$pval / 100
```

Define p-curving function
```{r}
alpha_ramp <- function(x, min_alpha=0.05, max_alpha=1, min=5, max=1000) {
  # raw ramp
  a <- max_alpha + (min_alpha-1) * (x - min) / (max - min)
  # clamp between 0.2 and 1
  pmin(max_alpha, pmax(min_alpha, a))
}


#' Plot original and fitted p-curves
#' @description Create a plot displaying the original and a number of fitted p-curves
#' @param simdat Result of simulation function
#' @param poriginal Original p-curve (vector)
#' @param GOF Goodness of fit measure: one of "rmse", "chi2", "g2" (default)
#' @param n_best Show only the n best curves. If NA, all are shown
#' @param alpha Alpha transparency for the simulated p-curve lines
#' @param n_studies Number of studies in the original p-curve (only needed for chi2 GOF)
#' @param tol Numeric tolerance for probability sum checks (default 1e-10).
#' @import ggplot2
#' @importFrom tidyr pivot_longer
#' @importFrom scales percent
#' @export

plot_pcurves_new <- function(simdat, poriginal, GOF = "g2", n_best=NA, alpha=NA, n_studies=NA, tol=1e-10, title = "", background_dat = NULL){
  stopifnot(all(poriginal >= 0) & all(poriginal <= 1))
  # Compute GOF between original and simulated
  if (GOF=="rmse") {
    simdat$GOF <- rmse(observed=poriginal, expected=simdat[, paste0("p", 1:5)])
  } else if (GOF=="chi2"){
    if (is.na(n_studies)) {
      stop("For chi2 GOF, n_studies must be provided")
    }
    simdat$GOF <- chi2(observed=poriginal, expected=simdat[, paste0("p", 1:5)], n=n_studies, tol = tol)
  } else if (GOF=="g2"){
    if (is.na(n_studies)) {
      stop("For G2 GOF, n_studies must be provided")
    }
    simdat$GOF <- g2(observed=poriginal, expected=simdat[, paste0("p", 1:5)], n=n_studies, tol = tol)
  } else {
    stop("GOF must be one of 'rmse', 'chi2', or 'g2'")
  }
  simdat$condition <- 1:nrow(simdat)
  # Selection: Order by GOF and extract the n_best curves (or all of them)
  if (is.na(n_best)) {
    n_best <- nrow(simdat)
  }
  simdat_sel <- simdat[order(simdat$GOF)[1:n_best], c("condition", paste0("p", 1:5))]
  simdat_sel_long <- pivot_longer(simdat_sel,
                                  cols = matches("p\\d"),
                                  values_to = "yval")
  simdat_sel_long$pval <- substr(simdat_sel_long$name, 2, 2) |> as.numeric()
  simdat_sel_long$pval <- simdat_sel_long$pval / 100
  plotdat <- data.frame(pval = seq(0.01, 0.05, by = 0.01),
                        yval = unlist(poriginal))
  if (is.na(alpha)) {
    alpha <- alpha_ramp(n_best)
  }
  
  p1 <- ggplot() +
    theme_bw() +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = percent,
      limits = c(0, 1)
    ) +
    labs(x = "p-value bin",
         y = "Percentage of p-values") +
    theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
          axis.text = element_text(size = 15),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 20))
  
  # Optionally add background lines first (so they render behind everything)
  if (!is.null(background_dat)) {
    p1 <- p1 + geom_line(data = background_dat, 
                         aes(y = yval, x = pval, group = sample.num),
                         color = "grey80", alpha = 0.4)
  }
  
  p1 <- p1 +
    geom_line(data = simdat_sel_long, aes(y = yval, x = pval, group = condition),
              color = "steelblue", alpha = 1, linewidth = 1) +
    geom_line(data = plotdat, aes(y = yval, x = pval, group = 1), linewidth = 1, alpha = .8) +
    ggtitle(title)
  
  p1
}
```



P-curve 1
```{r}
plot_1 <-  plot_pcurves_new(simres |> filter(condition == "multDV_realistic"), poriginal = simplify2array(pcurves[1, paste0("p", 1:5)]), n_best = 5, GOF="g2", n_studies = pcurves$nsig[1], tol = 1e-6, title = "Realistic World: Multiple DVs", background_dat = pcurves500_long |> filter(dataset == "2010-2012"))

plot_2 <- plot_pcurves_new(simres |> filter(condition == "optStop_realistic"), poriginal = simplify2array(pcurves[1, paste0("p", 1:5)]), n_best = 1, GOF="g2", n_studies = pcurves$nsig[1], tol = 1e-6, title = "Realistic World: Optional Stopping", background_dat = pcurves500_long |> filter(dataset == "2010-2012"))

plot_3 <- plot_pcurves_new(simres |> filter(condition == "multDV_worst"), poriginal = simplify2array(pcurves[1, paste0("p", 1:5)]), n_best = 5, GOF="g2", n_studies = pcurves$nsig[1], tol = 1e-6, title = "Worst World: Multiple DVs", background_dat = pcurves500_long |> filter(dataset == "2010-2012"))

plot_4 <- plot_pcurves_new(simres |> filter(condition == "optStop_worst"), poriginal = simplify2array(pcurves[1, paste0("p", 1:5)]), n_best = 5, GOF="g2", n_studies = pcurves$nsig[1], tol = 1e-6, title = "Worst World: Optional Stopping", background_dat = pcurves500_long |> filter(dataset == "2010-2012"))

plot_5 <- plot_pcurves_new(simres |> filter(condition == "multDV_perfect"), poriginal = simplify2array(pcurves[1, paste0("p", 1:5)]), n_best = 5, GOF="g2", n_studies = pcurves$nsig[1], tol = 1e-6, title = "Perfect World", background_dat = pcurves500_long |> filter(dataset == "2010-2012"))

plot_6 <- plot_pcurves_new(simres |> filter(condition == "multDV_H0"), poriginal = simplify2array(pcurves[1, paste0("p", 1:5)]), n_best = 1, GOF="g2", n_studies = pcurves$nsig[1], tol = 1e-6, title = "Flat World", background_dat = pcurves500_long |> filter(dataset == "2010-2012"))

plot_1 + plot_2 + plot_3 + plot_4 + plot_5 + plot_6

no_y <- theme(
  axis.title.y = element_blank(),
  axis.text.y = element_blank(),
  axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
)

(plot_1 | plot_2 + no_y | plot_3 + no_y) / (plot_4 | plot_5 + no_y | plot_6 + no_y)
```
